name: Idol Crush
source:
Idol Crush is a Visual Novel game that gives its readers an opportunity to find Saino Aru Academy's Miyuki Watanabe's high school sweetheart. With three gorgeous school idols to choose from, Miyuki has the way to somehow seduce one of them.

[From [url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=8930]Lemma Soft Forums[/url]]
